metadata.name: copywriting
metadata.description: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page, including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says "write copy for," "improve this copy," "rewrite this page," "marketing copy," "headline help," "CTA copy," "value proposition," "tagline," "hero section copy," "this copy is weak," "this sounds like AI," "AI slop," "make it sound human," or "help me describe my product." Drafts never use AI tells like "it's not X, it's Y" reveals, "no X, no Y, no Z" lists, or sentences that trail into extra comma clauses. For email copy, see emails. For popup copy, see popups. For editing existing copy, see copy-editing. For the offer underneath the copy (bonuses, guarantees, value framing), see offers. Claims must be supportable, and a declined claim names the evidence that would unlock it. Diagnoses the input first (blank brief, real voice, or point edit) and changes only what it calls for.
metadata.reason: Texto e referências passivas, sem scripts no pacote; inclui evals/evals.json como dado, não executor. Preservar avisos/atribuições e revisar natural-transitions antes de distribuição/adaptação como MIT integral.
requirements: Ferramentas, dados e efeitos exigem autorização e capacidade próprias.
losses: Corpo original não embarcado: indisponível no importador/condições atuais; sem substituto traduzido.
